repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是基于 MCP 协议的逆向工程智能体框架，支持原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集及网页的多平台分析。通过对接 Hopper、Ghidra、IDA 等专业工具，让 AI 智能体在本地完成代码审查与行为逆向，输出带证据链的结论，适用于竞品分析与安全研究。
repos.summary_en: REA is an MCP-based reverse engineering agent framework supporting multi-platform analysis of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It connects to Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA for local code inspection and behavioral reverse engineering with evidence-backed conclusions, ideal for competitive analysis and security research.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库逆向工程整理了30余款主流AI编程工具的系统提示词与内部机制，涵盖Cursor、Claude Code、Devin AI、Windsurf等核心产品。提供超过30,000行真实配置，为开发者、安全研究员和架构师提供罕见的AI代理架构底层洞察，适用于提示词工程优化、竞品分析和AI安全研究。
repos.summary_en: This repository reverse-engineers and aggregates system prompts and internal mechanisms from 30+ mainstream AI coding tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Devin AI, and Windsurf. With over 30,000 lines of actual configurations, it offers unprecedented insights into AI agent architectures for prompt engineering optimization, competitive analysis, and AI security research.

repos.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
repos.summary_zh: Ghidra是NSA开源的软件逆向工程框架，提供反汇编、反编译、图形化分析与脚本扩展能力，支持多平台、多处理器指令集。可用于恶意代码分析、漏洞挖掘与团队协作逆向，支持交互与自动化模式，并允许用Java/Python开发扩展，是高端可定制的SRE研究平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghidra is an open-source software reverse engineering framework by the NSA, offering disassembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting. It supports multiple platforms and processor architectures, enabling malware analysis, vulnerability research, and collaborative SRE in both interactive and automated modes, with extensibility via Java or Python.

repos.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
repos.summary_zh: reverse-skill 是一个面向 AI 编码客户端的逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究技能路由包。它通过 AI 驱动的路由矩阵与 RULES.md，自动将 APK、二进制、JS 加密、CTF、固件等任务导向正确方法论和工具链。核心亮点包括按需自举工具链、自进化知识库，以及与 IDA Pro、Ghidra、Frida 等集成，避免盲目猜命令，实现经验复用。支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等客户端，多平台部署，显著提升安全研究效率。
repos.summary_en: reverse-skill is an AI-powered skill router pack for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research, designed for AI coding clients like Claude Code and Cursor. It automatically routes tasks involving APKs, binaries, JS encryption, CTF, and firmware to the correct methodologies and tools via a routing matrix and RULES.md. Highlights include on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, a self-evolving knowledge base, and integration with IDA Pro, Ghidra, and Frida. It prevents blind command guessing, enables experience reuse, and supports cross-platform deployments for efficient security workflows.

repos.description: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
repos.summary_zh: Craft Anything 是一款纯 Rust 编写的开源逆向工程与 AI 克隆引擎。它能深入分析任意网站、应用或游戏的运行机制，借助真实检查工具研究原始实现，再让 AI 编码代理生成新项目，并自动比对结果、迭代优化，最终产出功能一致的替代版本。跨平台支持桌面与 Web。
repos.summary_en: Craft Anything is an open-source, clean-room engine written in pure Rust that reverse-engineers any website, app, or game. It studies the original with real inspection tools, has an AI coding agent build a new project, then checks the result against the original and iteratively refines it to produce a functionally equivalent clone. Cross-platform for desktop and web.

repos.description: High-performance browser automation bridge and multi-instance orchestrator with advanced stealth injection and real-time dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: PinchTab 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高性能浏览器自动化桥接器。通过 12MB 的 Go 二进制文件提供 HTTP API，支持多实例 Chrome 进程 orchestration 与隐身注入。核心突破在于 token 效率——文本提取仅需 800 tokens/页，成本比截图方案低 5-13 倍。具备持久化配置文件、ARM64 优化和实时仪表板，是 AI 驱动 Web 自动化的轻量级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: PinchTab is a high-performance browser automation bridge designed for AI agents. This 12MB Go binary delivers HTTP API for multi-instance Chrome orchestration with advanced stealth injection. Its breakthrough is token efficiency—text extraction costs only 800 tokens/page, 5-13x cheaper than screenshots. Featuring persistent profiles, ARM64 optimization, and real-time dashboard, it's the lightweight infrastructure for AI-driven web automation.

repos.description: ChatGPT 官网接口纯协议逆向实现，Go 语言编写，高并发、低内存、高性能。指纹级请求还原，支持 GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图、GIF 动图、文本模型与语音合成/转写，兼容 OpenAI 接口协议，在线批量生图，号池管理，支持导入 CPA、sub2api 号池，可接入 Cherry Studio、New API 等软件
repos.summary_zh: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

repos.description: An Xposed module to intercept applist detections
repos.summary_zh: 基于Xposed框架的Android隐私保护模块，通过拦截应用列表请求隐藏已安装应用，防止其他应用检测Root工具来识别设备Root状态，同时抵御基于应用列表的指纹追踪，并提供隐藏效果验证功能。
repos.summary_en: An Xposed module for Android that intercepts app list requests to hide installed applications from other apps. It prevents apps from detecting root-related tools (such as Fake Location or Storage Isolation) that would reveal a device is rooted. Additionally, it blocks apps from using app list enumeration as fingerprinting data or for other nefarious purposes. The module also provides built-in verification methods to test whether app list hiding is working properly, ensuring comprehensive privacy protection on rooted Android devices.

repos.description: 🚀 Transparent proxy injector for Antigravity. Force SOCKS5/HTTP proxy without TUN mode on Windows. | 专为 Antigravity 打造的免 TUN 强制代理工具，支持 DLL 注入与进程流量劫持。
repos.summary_zh: Antigravity-Proxy 是专为 Google Antigravity AI 编辑器设计的 Windows 透明代理注入工具。通过 DLL 注入（version.dll 等）和 MinHook 钩子，精准劫持 language_server、node.exe 等进程的网络流量，强制走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，无需 Clash TUN 模式。核心价值在于进程级流量控制，避免全局代理影响本地开发，解决中国用户系统代理不生效痛点。支持详细日志诊断与 IP 出口检测，C++17 实现，部署简单。
repos.summary_en: Antigravity-Proxy is a Windows-specific transparent proxy injector tailored for Google's Antigravity AI-powered agentic IDE. It uses DLL injection (e.g., version.dll) and MinHook to hijack network traffic from Antigravity processes like language_server_windows_x64.exe and node.exe, forcing SOCKS5/HTTP proxy routing without TUN mode. This enables selective proxying for Chinese users facing system proxy bypass issues, avoiding global traffic impact. Features C++17 implementation, detailed logging, IP diagnostics for location restrictions, and easy deployment to the app directory.

repos.description: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
repos.summary_zh: Dembrandt 是一款一键提取任意网站设计系统的 CLI 工具。基于 Playwright 渲染页面并分析 DOM 计算样式，自动输出 Logo、颜色、字体、间距、边框、阴影、动效与组件等完整设计令牌，支持 W3C DTCG、shadcn/ui、Tailwind 等多格式导出，并可在 CI 中检测设计漂移，生成品牌指南或供 AI 代理使用。
repos.summary_en: Dembrandt is a CLI tool that extracts any website’s design system into standardized tokens in one command. Powered by Playwright, it analyzes computed DOM styles to capture logo, colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and components. Outputs W3C DTCG, shadcn/ui, Tailwind themes and more; supports CI drift detection, brand guides and AI-agent ready DESIGN.md.

repos.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
repos.summary_zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
repos.summary_en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

repos.description: In-place tweak injection with insert_dylib and ChOma.
repos.summary_zh: TrollFools 是一款专为 TrollStore 设计的轻量级 tweak 注入工具，利用 insert_dylib 和 ChOma 实现 Mach-O 二进制文件的原地动态库注入。支持 iOS 14-17 系统应用及 App Store 应用的修改，无论是解密还是加密状态。采用 SwiftUI 开发，界面现代且体积小巧，旨在替代有缺陷的 optool，为越狱社区提供高效稳定的 tweak 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: TrollFools is a lightweight tweak injection tool specifically designed for TrollStore ecosystem, leveraging insert_dylib and ChOma to perform in-place dynamic library injection directly into Mach-O binaries. It supports iOS 14-17, capable of modifying removable system applications, decrypted App Store apps, and even encrypted App Store apps with bare dynamic libraries. Written entirely in SwiftUI, it delivers a modern user interface while maintaining a small package size. The project aims to replace the problematic optool by compiling a statically linked install_name_tool, providing the jailbreak community with a more reliable and efficient solution for tweak deployment.

repos.description: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议等六大领域的逆向工程工具、案例与论文，共5000余项资源，均经来源审查，支持中英双语，为安全研究、漏洞挖掘和软件分析提供一站式导航。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates tools, case studies, and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware, and protocols. With over 5,000 resources, all source-reviewed and bilingual, it serves as a comprehensive hub for security research, vulnerability discovery, and software analysis.

repos.description: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP. Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.summary_zh: x64dbg-MCP Server 是用 Zig 编写的原生 MCP 插件，为零依赖单文件，支持 x32/x64。它通过 HTTP/SSE 暴露 x64dbg 全部调试功能（断点、单步、内存读写、寄存器、反汇编、符号、PE分析等84个工具），让任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手可程序化控制调试器，实现智能体驱动的逆向工程。
repos.summary_en: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Zig-built MCP plugin for x64dbg with zero dependencies and single-binary output for both x32/x64. It exposes full debugger capabilities (84 tools: breakpoints, stepping, memory, registers, disassembly, PE analysis, etc.) over HTTP/SSE, enabling any MCP-compatible AI assistant to programmatically control the debugger for agentic reverse engineering.

repos.description: AI Red Teaming playground labs to run AI Red Teaming trainings including infrastructure.
repos.summary_zh: 微软AI红队演练实验室提供系统化的AI系统渗透测试实战训练。该仓库源自Black Hat USA 2024课程，包含凭证窃取、元提示提取、Crescendo多轮攻击等多样化挑战场景。基于Chat Copilot架构构建，集成PyRIT自动化工具实现攻击流程脚本化，覆盖直接提示注入、对抗性机器学习等新型风险。为安全专业人员提供从理论到实践的完整AI红队技能培养体系，支持Microsoft Learn官方教程视频联动。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft AI Red Teaming Playground Labs delivers hands-on training for systematically assessing AI system vulnerabilities. Originating from Black Hat USA 2024, this repository provides practical challenges including credential exfiltration, metaprompt extraction, and multi-turn Crescendo attacks. Built on Chat Copilot infrastructure, it integrates PyRIT automation framework to script adversarial testing workflows. The labs cover novel attack vectors beyond traditional security, incorporating adversarial machine learning and Responsible AI failures. Designed for security professionals, it offers a complete skill development path with Jupyter notebooks and Microsoft Learn video tutorials.

repos.description: Jailed in-app purchase cracker (iOS 12-16)
repos.summary_zh: SatellaJailed 是一款专为 iOS 12-16 设计的应用内购买破解工具，支持非越狱（jailed）和部分越狱设备。通过动态库注入技术，它能在应用购买流程中拦截并绕过苹果的支付验证机制。工具提供三种安装方式：电脑脚本自动打补丁、Azula 应用补丁和 Esign 签名集成，支持 TrollStore 和 Dopamine 环境。使用时发起购买后取消确认弹窗即可。核心功能默认启用，iOS 15+ 用户可开启高级选项。注意并非所有应用都兼容。
repos.summary_en: SatellaJailed is an iOS 12-16 in-app purchase cracker designed for jailed and partially jailbroken devices. It employs dynamic library injection to intercept and bypass Apple's payment verification during purchase flows. The tool offers three installation methods: computer-based script patching, Azula app patching, and Esign signature integration, compatible with TrollStore and Dopamine environments. Users initiate a purchase and cancel the Apple ID confirmation popup to activate. Core functionality is enabled by default, with advanced features available for iOS 15+. Note that not all applications are supported, and success rates may vary depending on the target app.

repos.description: 🦊 内置 AI 逆向 Agent 的 Firefox — 通用 JS/JSVMP/WASM/签名逆向工作站，SpiderMonkey 引擎层非侵入 trace，把加密参数从黑盒还原成不依赖浏览器的纯算法
repos.summary_zh: Firefox-Reverse是一款内置AI逆向Agent的定制Firefox浏览器。通过SpiderMonkey引擎层非侵入trace，将网页JS/JSVMP/WASM/签名等加密参数从黑盒还原为独立Node.js/Python算法。同时支持独立profile和进程的指纹环境隔离管理。兼容DeepSeek等多家大模型，内置64个工具，实现自动化抓包、trace与验证。适用于API逆向、网页爬虫开发及安全研究场景。
repos.summary_en: Firefox-Reverse is a customized Firefox browser with a built-in AI reverse engineering Agent. It employs non-intrusive tracing at the SpiderMonkey engine layer to convert black-box JS, JSVMP, WASM, and signature parameters from web pages into standalone Node.js or Python algorithms. It also provides fingerprint environment management via isolated profiles and processes. Compatible with multiple LLMs and featuring 64 tools, it enables automated tracing, verification, and environment handling for API reverse engineering, web scraping, and security research.

repos.description: DeepSeek 逆向 API
repos.summary_zh: DeepSeek2API通过逆向工程将DeepSeek模型封装为OpenAI兼容接口，支持deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner等模型。核心特性包括高速流式输出、多轮对话、R1深度思考及多账号轮换机制，有效分散单账号风险。提供Docker、Vercel及原生部署方案，配置灵活。项目明确声明仅限研究学习使用，禁止商用，规避官方服务压力与封号风险。
repos.summary_en: DeepSeek2API wraps DeepSeek models into OpenAI-compatible interfaces via reverse engineering, supporting deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner and search variants. Key features include high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversation, R1 deep reasoning, and multi-account rotation to mitigate single-account limitations. Offers flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or native Python. Project explicitly for research/learning only, prohibiting commercial use to avoid official service pressure and account bans.

repos.description: 基于 LSPosed 框架的 Android 系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。Fakelocation module based on LSPosed which is available to GMS.
repos.summary_zh: Shadow是一款基于LSPosed框架的Android系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。通过底层Hook系统服务与高德/腾讯地图SDK，实现GPS、基站、Wi-Fi的全维度位置模拟及指纹伪造，支持防跳回与GMS兼容。核心价值在于比传统Mock Location更强的隐蔽性，适用于隐私保护、应用测试与位置模拟场景，技术亮点为系统层劫持与随机环境生成。
repos.summary_en: Shadow is an LSPosed-based Android module for system-level virtual location and environment spoofing. It hooks system services and map SDKs (Gaode/Tencent) to fake GPS, cell info, and Wi-Fi lists with anti-rebound features and GMS compatibility. Core value lies in superior stealth over traditional mock location via low-level file interactions. Ideal for privacy protection and app testing, with highlights in system-layer hooking and random fingerprint generation.

repos.description: An intentionally vulnerable OWASP LLM Top 10 training platform for AI Security, Prompt Injection, RAG Security, Agent Security, and GenAI penetration testing.
repos.summary_zh: LLMVault 是一个故意漏洞的 CTF 风格训练平台，专为 OWASP LLM Top 10（2025）设计。提供 25 个三层实验室：核心层 10 个单类漏洞实验（提示注入、信息泄露、供应链、数据投毒等）；高级层 10 个多轮交互挑战（越狱、Agent 利用、RAG 攻击）；专家层 5 个真实攻击模拟。每实验室结合攻击与防御实践。Docker 就绪、Python 构建，适用于自托管 AI 安全教育与 GenAI 渗透测试。
repos.summary_en: LLMVault is a deliberately vulnerable CTF-style training platform for OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025). It features 25 labs across three tiers: 10 core labs covering prompt injection, sensitive info disclosure, supply chain, data poisoning and more; 10 advanced multi-turn challenges including jailbreaking, agent exploitation and RAG attacks; plus 5 expert labs modeling real-world threats. Each lab pairs exploitation with defenses. Docker-ready and Python-based, ideal for self-hosted AI security education, GenAI penetration testing and hands-on LLM defense training.
